cohort: Pregnant women with laboratory-confirmed or laboratory-denied SARS-CoV-2 infection at the time of delivery hospitalization
finding: Preterm and cesarean birth rates did not differ between women with and without SARS-CoV-2 infection, but babies born to women with SARS-CoV-2 were more likely to have complications of prematurity or low birth weight.
mod_finding: Rates of preterm birth and cesarean birth did not differ between women with and without SARS-CoV-2 infection.
